results.question: What did I spend on groceries in the second half of 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND (
    LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%rewe%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%aldi%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%lidl%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%edeka%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%kaufland%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%netto%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%auchand%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%cosamo%'
  )
GROUP BY
  topic
ORDER BY
  topic
LIMIT 200

results.question: Was gebe ich pro Woche im Schnitt fuer Lebensmittel aus?

  ROUND(-SUM(amount) * 4.166666666666667 / COUNT(DISTINCT STRFTIME('%W', booked_on)), 2) AS avg_per_week_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-28'
  AND (
    LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%rewe%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%aldi%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%lidl%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%edeka%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%kaufland%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%netto%'
    OR LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%dm drogerie%'
    OR LOWER(category) = 'groceries'
